nodes.statement: For m >= 1, G_m is the graph on 20m+31 vertices: spine pentagons S_0..S_m (5-cycles labelled a..e), leaf pentagons L_{i,x} attached by the edge S_i[x]--L_{i,x}[X], spine edges S_i[c]--S_{i+1}[a], and one extra vertex v adjacent to the four non-attachment vertices of every leaf pentagon.
In any proper 3-colouring of G_m, the attachment vertex of every leaf pentagon has the same colour as v.

Spine propagation: (1) if S_0[a],S_0[b],S_0[d],S_0[e] avoid colour alpha then S_0[c] has colour alpha; (2) same for internal S_i; (3) if S_m[b],S_m[c],S_m[d],S_m[e] avoid alpha then S_m[a] has colour alpha.
For every edge e of G_m, G_m minus e is 2-degenerate; hence every proper subgraph of G_m is 3-colourable.
Every cycle in G_m minus v is contained in a single pentagon block and has no chords.
For a cycle C through v and a visited leaf pentagon Q, at most 4 chords of C are counted in Q.
nodes.check: enumeration: max chords over all cycles through v = 10 >= per-block bound

nodes.statement: For a cycle C through v: no chord is counted in an internal spine block, and at most 1 chord in each of the two end spine blocks.
Every cycle C of G_m satisfies ch_{G_m}(C) <= 10.
nodes.check: verify_section4b.py: max chords over all cycles through v = 10 exactly (m=1:11456, m=2:32776, m=3:79184 cycles)

nodes.statement: For every m >= 1, G_m is a K4-free graph on 20m+31 vertices with chromatic number 4, every proper subgraph 2-degenerate, and every cycle having at most 10 chords.
nodes.check: combines L4.2, P4.5, P4.5b, P4.6, P4.10; all numeric parts machine-checked

nodes.statement: There is no function f : Nat -> Nat with f(r) -> infinity such that every 4-chromatic graph whose subgraphs on at most r vertices are 3-colourable contains an odd cycle with at least f(r) chords.
nodes.check: logical consequence of T4.1 (take G_m with m >= r/20)
